title.narrative: Programme Management and Strategy Support Team (PMSST)

description.narrative: The Forest Governance, Markets and Climate (FGMC) Programme is a flagship UK government initiative aimed at tackling the drivers of illegal deforestation and promoting sustainable forest governance and land use across key tropical forest regions. Its second phase, FGMC2 (2025–2030), seeks to consolidate previous achievements while adapting to evolving global challenges such as climate change, biodiversity loss, and human rights concerns. Central to the implementation of FGMC2 is the Programme Management, Support and Services Team (PMSST), which is tasked with managing and administering the programme’s extensive grant portfolio—valued at up to £73 million and spread across approximately 20 to 25 accountable grants. The PMSST will provide technical, strategic, financial, and operational support to FCDO, ensuring that grants are aligned with the FGMC2 Theory of Change and contribute to a well-governed, transparent, and sustainable forest sector. Specifically, the PMSST will manage the full grant lifecycle, from early scoping and due diligence through to disbursement, monitoring, and evaluation. It will coordinate grantee support, facilitate programme learning, and ensure financial oversight, including forecasting, value-for-money assessments, and compliance with FCDO’s rigorous standards. In doing so, the PMSST aims to foster coherent, evidence-informed delivery that strengthens rights, promotes legal and sustainable trade in forest products, and supports climate and biodiversity goals across FGMC partner countries.

recipient-region.narrative: Target countries include, but not limited to: Côte d’Ivoire, Ghana, Liberia, Cameroon, Central African Republic, Democratic Republic of the Congo, Republic of the Congo, Guyana, China, India, Indonesia, Myanmar, Vietnam, Solomon Islands, Papua New Guinea
